card.description:
**Ready to lead planning that delivers?**
-----------------------------------------

If building world-class planning systems for medical, aerospace, industrial, and scientific products sounds exciting, you’ll feel at home at Hirsh Precision. We blend software, advanced manufacturing techniques, and modern systems to improve lives—and we back it with a culture of integrity, quality, service, and excellence.

### **Your impact**

* Set the standard for MRP execution—from buy planning and material master governance to inventory control, warehousing, and logistics.
* Translate business objectives into aligned plans with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Finance.
* Elevate affordability and performance through continuous improvement.
* Grow a capable, engaged team through coaching, training, performance feedback, and recognition.
* Craft production schedules that balance on-time delivery with optimal capacity usage.
* Oversee shop orders, priorities, and work center load; course-correct as reality shifts.
* Partner with Operations, Purchasing, and Sales Operations to get ahead of constraints in materials, labor, and equipment.
* Be the go-to contact for schedule questions and escalations.
* Advance scheduling processes, tools, reports, and efficiency through iterative improvements.
* Safeguard data integrity in BPCS and deliver meaningful KPIs and performance metrics.
* Brief executive stakeholders with clear, actionable reporting.

### **What you bring**

#### **Education**

* Bachelor’s in Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* APICS/ASCM CPIM certification

#### **Experience**

* 8–12 years in manufacturing planning, supply chain, or operations management
* 3+ years leading cross-functional or multi-disciplined teams

#### **Technical chops**

* Hands-on experience with mid/upper-tier ERP platforms
* Analytical strength with KPI dashboarding and data-governance know-how

#### **Leadership strengths**

* Persuasive communicator who influences at all levels
* Proven talent developer and mentor

#### **Core capabilities**

* Data-first problem solving
* Change leadership
* Continuous improvement orientation

#### **Bonus skills**

* Strategic execution—long-view thinking with roll-up-your-sleeves delivery
* Mentorship & team building—create high-performing teams and succession pathways
* Business acumen—turn data into cost savings and operational excellence
* Collaboration—excel in matrixed settings; promote knowledge sharing
* Innovation mindset—introduce tools, processes, and best practices to elevate PP&C

### **Tools & tech**

* ERP & MRP Systems
* ERP Software (BPCS for scheduling integrity and reporting)

### **Why Hirsh?**

You’ll shape how work flows through our factory—and how quickly life-improving products reach customers. We’ll give you the platform to experiment, iterate, and win together.

card.title: Director, Instrument Manufacturing
card.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The primary purpose of this position is to plan and direct departmental functions (Instrument Manufacturing, Engineering, Instrument Refurbishing) at the St. Louis Operations site to ensure achievement of the corporate goals and objectives of the worldwide bioMerieux organization. This position is responsible for the manufacture and maintenance of instrument production and refurbishment through oversight of multiple teams. In addition, this position: provides technical expertise and quality support through implementation of projects and continuous improvement activities; identifies and justifies projects for capital funding, and deliver the projects on time and budget. Also requires coordinating and overseeing the implementation of engineering projects related to cost improvements and new product introductions, ensuring cooperation within and outside the department at both the local and global levels. And finally, responsible for developing and maintaining an engaged, motivated and skilled production work force.

**Primary Duties**
==================

* Manage Manufacturing – Manage the manufacturing and refurbishment groups to ensure customer satisfaction. Deliver the forecasted product on schedule with no errors or nonconformities. Maintain the complex manufacturing process and minimize loss. Maintain high employee morale, drive cooperation between departments at both local and global levels, and drive employee career development.
* Manage and Maintain Production Equipment – Ensure that the manufacturing areas are maintained so that production can continuously manufacture and refurbish product. End result: Successfully manufacturer product to meet demand and improve efficiency to reduce the COGS.
* Product Transfer – Manage the transfer of new products from Research to Manufacturing. Validate the new processes to meet regulatory requirements and ensure the necessary procedures are in place to order parts / materials to meet market demand. End result: Successful market introduction of new, high quality products that meet all relevant and applicable regulatory requirements.
* CAPA Investigations – Manage and provide technical expertise to projects related to investigating failures in current product production or testing processes.
* Cost Improvement and Risk Management – Manage and provide technical expertise to justify and implement cost improvement projects in Operations.
* Finance – Ensure adherence to Departmental budgets.
* Personnel – hiring, maintenance, organization, engagement, and performance of qualified manufacturing, engineering, and other personnel.
* Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures and standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree required– Engineering, Supply Chain Management, R&D, Business, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience leading manufacturing operations, with budget oversight and demonstrated experience in cost reduction and operational efficiency.
* 3+ years experience managing operations in an ISO 13485 regulated manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading transformational change.
* Demonstrated experience in talent management and succession planning.
* Experience with capacity, automation, capital investments preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
====================================

* Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes.
* Comfortable giving clear, direct, and actionable feedback.
* Driving continuous improvement by evaluating processes and implementing necessary changes.
* Inspire and energize individuals to achieve their best performance.
* Drive for Results while successfully removing barriers.
* Communicates instructions clearly and effectively.
* Advanced Microsoft Suite Skills: demonstrates deep knowledge; manages complex tasks and integrates multiple tools independently.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
================================

* Direct supervision of approximately 1–5 employees.
* Indirect supervision of approximately 100+ employees.
* Required to make financial, manufacturing process, organizational changes, product and team development decisions.

**Working Conditions**
======================

* Domestic travel required: 10% of time
* International travel required: 5% of time
* Total travel: 15%

The estimated salary range for this role is between $155,000-$198,000. This role is eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and individual performance per bioMérieux’s bonus program. This range may differ from ranges offered for similar positions elsewhere in the country given differences in cost of living. Actual compensation within this range is determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and will be presented in writing at the time of the offer.

In addition, bioMérieux offers a competitive Total Rewards package that may include:

* A choice of medical (including prescription), dental, and vision plans providing nationwide coverage and telemedicine options

* Company-Provided Life and Accidental Death Insurance

* Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance

* Retirement Plan including a generous non-discretionary employer contribution and employer match.

* Adoption Assistance

* Wellness Programs

* Employee Assistance Program

* Commuter Benefits

* Various voluntary benefit offerings

* Discount programs

* Parental leaves

card.title: VP, Production - Soft Accessories
card.description:
About Us:

Centric Brands is a leading lifestyle brand collective that designs, sources, markets and sells high quality products in multiple segments, including women’s, men’s and kid’s apparel, accessories, entertainment and beauty. Centric Brands is focused on our customers and our brands that will drive the company’s future growth. We are defined by innovation as we seize new opportunities and thrive in an environment informed by creativity and thinking that is both analytical and outside the box. Centric Brands reflects a team built on respect, for others and for the hard work it takes to achieve our goals and build our bright future together.

**Production**

From sourcing raw materials to manufacturing, order placement, pricing and quality control and getting the finished product where it needs to be, our production team is responsible for ensuring we keep our standards high and our business profitable at every step of the journey. If you are a focused, results -driven, tenacious and highly flexible team player, we’ll give you every opportunity to build a rewarding career with one of the world’s foremost major lifestyle brand collectives.

Specific Responsibilities Would Include:

Centric Brands is looking for a dynamic, creative and resourceful Vice President of Production, Soft Accessories, to join its team. This individual must be a self-starter and collaborative leader who takes initiative, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is excited to accelerate transformation across Centric Brands. The Vice President of Production, Soft Accessories, oversees all facets of global development, manufacturing and supply chain operations for cold weather accessories, including scarves, gloves, hats, beanies and related knit accessories. This leader will identify and manage the appropriate vendors and factories, negotiate manufacturing orders, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality, profitable goods.

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategy & Innovation**

 

* Partner with corporate resources to achieve global production efficiencies across divisions and groups
* Lead ongoing market and competitive research to identify innovations in leather, knitwear, yarns, fibers, fabrications, construction, trims and finishing techniques. Translate relevant developments into actionable recommendations for Merchandising and Design, and maintain a current archive of yarns, materials, hardware and production techniques.

**Operations and Results**

* Oversee and continuously evaluate the approved vendor matrix for cold weather accessories, with particular focus on factories with strong technical capabilities in knit scarves, gloves (knit & leather), hats, beanies and related accessories. Review costing, capacity, quality and production standards.
* Lead high-level negotiations on yarn, material, trim and finished-goods pricing to ensure profitability. Approve final buys; oversee production from development samples through final delivery; resolve vendor non-compliance, claims and chargebacks; and coordinate customs classification requirements with Imports.
* Partner with Merchandising, Design and Sales throughout product development to ensure accurate execution of cold weather accessories, including stitch, gauge, yarn, handfeel, fit, construction, color and finishing. Deliver agreed-upon margin goals and development-calendar milestones across the assortment.
* Review production standards and brand consistency across categories and vendors. Oversee quality-control initiatives, including testing and corrective action plans for yarn performance, pilling, shrinkage, colorfastness, seam strength, embellishments, trims and overall product durability.
* Lead high-level troubleshooting of quality and technical issues. Guide special product development and modifications to designs, materials, stitches and constructions while protecting the intended aesthetic, performance and financial goals.
* Oversee capacity planning and vendor performance by sourcing office, region, country and factory. Define accurate costing models; partner with Sales and Planning to project production needs; make yarn and raw-material commitments when appropriate; allocate production; and reserve factory capacity for seasonal peaks.
* any issues

**Customers & Relationships**

* Partner with customers, Sales, Merchandising and Operations, as well as vendors and factories to ensure adequate flow of goods relative to orders and anticipated demand criteria
* Oversee interoffice communication and follow-up with internal and external customers and contacts regarding production, including suppliers and vendors
* Delegate special projects as assigned
* Travel regularly to factories and international trade shows

**Leadership & Teams**

* Lead, train and motivate global team of full-time and part-time personnel as well as factory and independent agents; strategize staffing needs across categories and brands, where appropriate
* Contribute positively to team dynamic and manage up where necessary
* Attract, develop and retain talent; create appropriate succession plans
* Monitor and evaluate performance of individuals and team(s)

Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have:

* Superior organizational skills and excellent communication skills; team oriented
* Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines, highly detail oriented and meticulous
* Creativity, technical capability and sensibility for merchandising/design
* Required hands-on production and sourcing experience in cold weather accessories, including scarves, gloves (knit & leather), hats, beanies and related knit accessories.
* Bachelor’s Degree
* 10+ years’ experience in production and sourcing; significant relevant experience in category
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Adobe products, SAP, CAD and Mac computers

Salary Range: $200,000 - $240,000

At Centric Brands, we believe our people are our greatest asset, and we seek to structure competitive compensation offers to ensure that we are able to attract and retain the best talent. Our job postings include an annual base salary range at the time of employment. The stated base salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on several factors, including the selected candidate's educational and professional experience, industry knowledge, location, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the selection process. Base salary is a part of a total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, annual bonus and other Centric Brands sponsored benefit programs.

**Be part of our growing community by getting involved with groups, teams and initiatives like Be Green, Be Giving, and Be Celebrated.**

**Centric Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

Please note that Centric Brands will only reach out to interview, make an offer of employment or conduct onboarding activities for candidates who have applied through our careers site. When interviewing for a position, the candidate experience will include live interaction, such as a video conference or telephone call, with a Recruiter and/or company employee(s). We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process. Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity. If you think you are a victim of an employment scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agency and/or visit the Federal Trade Commission website here: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

card.title: Cement Plant Manager
card.description:
The ideal candidate is a proven cement manufacturing leader with extensive experience managing plant operations, including production, maintenance and reliability, quality, engineering, process optimization, safety, environmental compliance, and capital projects. This individual will combine strong technical knowledge of cement manufacturing with business and financial acumen, including experience managing operating and capital budgets, improving equipment reliability and plant efficiency, and controlling manufacturing costs. We are looking for a visible, hands-on leader who develops strong teams, drives accountability, and has a demonstrated ability to improve safety, reliability, quality, production, and overall plant performance.
 
 
**Who we are:** 
GCC is a world-class company that produces, distributes and markets cement, ready-mixed concrete, aggregates, and innovative products related to the construction industries in Mexico and the United States. We take pride in being a market leader with a culture of innovation, high performance and safety. GCC offers a very competitive benefits program including paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability insurance plans, and a 401K.
 
 
**What you will do:** 
Directs, coordinates and administers all production, quality control, maintenance, engineering, purchasing and process control activities required in meeting the operations budget objectives and maintains alignment with the strategic plans of GCCA for the preservation of the plant's physical assets and to meet projected sales goals. Directs and coordinates activities to obtain optimum efficiency and economy of operations and maximize profits by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate managers and supervisors.
 
 

* Responsible for planning, directing, organizing and scheduling all manufacturing and quality control activities for the effective operation of the plant.
* Plans and direct the plant machinery and mobile equipment preventive maintenance program and all major maintenance projects and activities.
* Plans and directs the expenditures of the capital program.
* Directs the engineering program involving technical support to production and maintenance, operational cost studies, construction and environmental controls.
* Conducts final reviews of and approves all plant budget forecasts, standards, staffing schedules and capital programs.
* Directs the inventory control of all materials, parts and supplies needed to support the operational activities.
* Investigates kiln output to fuel consumption; finish grinding production to power consumption; equipment failures and effects of repair recommendations; expenditures and return on investment; studies manufacturing costs in relation to budget; initiates and reviews studies, analyzes data interpretations concerned with the production, engineering technical service, purchasing, employment costs and other operations support activities.
* Plans the annual operation and capital budgets; the overall manufacturing capabilities of the plant; and the manufacturing schedule.
* Develops long-range plans for plant operations, capital programs, and raw material reserves and personnel requirements.
* Establishes performance standards for the operational departments including all cost and man-hour standards; policy governing control of product quality standards; the maintenance, repairs and construction budgets; and the necessary quantity and quality levels of all raw materials and fuels used by the plant.
* Hires, counsels, and trains assigned personnel, set individual goals, evaluates performance, recommends salary adjustments, promotion or transfer, approves time-off, and accomplishes objectives through the qualities of strong leadership.
* Directs the efforts to maintain compliance with all city, county, state and federal regulations; maintains a cordial working relationship with the surrounding community.
* Cooperates with the Senior Staff of GCCA in advising of company policies and procedures, safety rules, disciplinary actions and grievance procedures.
* Coordinates activities of departments such as operating, quality control, engineering, and maintenance with GCCA planning, sales, process, or research and development, to effect operational efficiency and economy.
* Analyzes plant budget requests to identify areas in which reductions can be made, and allocates operating budget.
* Confers with administrative personnel and reviews activity, operating, and sales reports to determine changes in programs or operations required.
* Promotes organization in industry, manufacturing or trade associations, Chamber of Commerce and community charities and agencies.

**Experience & abilities you will need:** 

* Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical, Mechanical, or Electromechanical Engineering.
* Master’s in Business Administration.
* Ten years’ experience in cement processes and business practices in the cement industry as well as ten years’ experience in maintenance, production, and quality control management.

**You will love working here because:** 
At GCC, employees are our most important resource. As a part of the GCC family, you'll be welcomed into a culture that promotes the company vision and internal career growth. Our company vision is to have our customers recognize us as a business partner that generates the most value to their construction projects. We're a sustainable growing company, a great place to work and a solid investment for our shareholders. GCC is an enterprise with a global and sustainable approach. Our production is mainly devoted to the manufacture and sale of gray Portland cement, mortar, premixed concrete, concrete blocks, plaster, aggregates and other construction materials. Join the family!

card.description:
Joining Kyuden Energy Partners means you’ll be joining a team in which employees are recognized as the backbone of the company. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes a 401K and provides a range of benefit options covering your wellness needs.
 
 
At Kyuden Energy Partners, diversity, respect, and inclusion are not simply initiatives, they are a commitment from the entire organization, treating everyone with respect, valuing people’s differences, and empowering everyone to have a voice.
 
 
Kyuden Energy Partners provides operations, maintenance, management, and power support services to the US Power Generation Industry across the United States. Our team is comprised of experts from diverse backgrounds of technical fields, including power operations, engineering, asset management, as well as finance, human resources, administration, safety and environmental. With this diverse background coupled with extensive years of employee experience, we provide exceptional operations, maintenance, management, and development expertise to a variety of power assets.
 
 
Kyuden Energy Partners Corporation (KEPC) has a career opportunity for a Power Plant Manager in Homer City, PA. The successful candidate will oversee all plant operations, maintenance, and facility functions, ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation while meeting performance, uptime, and client requirements.
 
 
Job Summary
 
The Plant Manager is responsible for directing all Operations and Maintenance (O&M) activities at the plant. The Plant Manager assures that an adequate supply of manpower, tools, equipment, and spare parts are always available to provide for the safe and efficient operation of the plant. The Plant Manager assures that the plant is operated in compliance with applicable safety, environmental, and power generating requirements.
 
 
The Plant Manager determines own practices and procedures, contributing to the development of new concepts, and performing duties independently with only general directions given. Decisions are made within policy constraints. The Plant Manager encounters new and varied work situations, extremely complex in nature. This is in conjunction with Kyuden Energy Partners Corporation (KEPC) and Owner policies and with the approval of the KEPC Chief Operating Officer or KEPC Director of Ops and the Owner's site representative.
 
 
The Plant Manager is accountable for the plant's long-range planning. The Plant Manager must effectively communicate information to the Director of Operations, Plant Supervisors, and client representatives relative to the overall operations of the plant. The Plant Manager must perform duties and ensure all plant personnel are performing duties in a safe manner resulting in no accidents, in compliance with all environmental permits at all times and in compliance with the applicable NERC Standards. The Plant Manager must perform duties, and ensure all plant personnel are performing duties, in such a way to result in an optimum cost-benefit ratio.
 
 
All employees have the responsibility to both the customer and their co-workers to do the job right the first time and to ensure the customer's needs are met.
 
 
Job Functions
 

* Responsible for ensuring that all plant personnel and plant objectives are aligned with client requirements.
* Administration and compliance with plant Safety, Operations, NERC, Maintenance, Administrative, Training, Chemistry and Environmental programs and ensure the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of the plant.
* Manage and oversee the performance of planned and unplanned plant outages.
* Implement training and qualification programs to assure that plant personnel are fully qualified to operate and maintain the facility and plant procedures are understood and properly followed by all plant personnel.
* Conduct periodic reviews of plant policies and procedures to ensure that they reflect current plant operating requirements.
* Direct the sourcing, screening, and hiring of new or replacement personnel as needed.
* Verify that the certification status of affected operation and maintenance personnel is maintained current.
* Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and development opportunities to plant personnel and ensure that the morale and motivation of plant personnel is always maintained at a high level.
* Develop a succession plan for key positions.
* Oversee the preparation of required client and utility reports, budgets, environmental compliance reports, etc.
* The Plant Manager supervises all site staff and has oversight responsibility for all contract work performed on behalf of the site (remote/on-site).
* The Plant Manager is the single point of contact between KEPC and the Owner on all matters pertaining to the operation and maintenance of the plant. The Plant Manager cooperates with other KEPC division managers as needed.
* The statements contained in this job description are not necessarily all inclusive; additional duties may be assigned, and requirements may vary from time to time.

* Bachelor of Science degree in engineering or equivalent field required.
* 10+ years of power plant or similar industry experience required.
* At least 10 years of experience supervising technical, supervisory, and administrative personnel.
* Must have 5 years’ experience in Gas Turbines or as a Power Plant Manager in another generation source.
* Strong leadership and motivational skills required.

* Must possess basic math skills, good verbal communications skills, and be proficient with the use of power and precision tools.
* Must be cooperative with those he/she contacts in this work and have the ability to work without direct supervision.
* Must know the hazards involved and the safety precautions to be practiced in the operation and maintenance of power plant equipment and machinery.
* Work within and insure strict adherence to all safety practices and procedures.
* Must be able to respond to audio alarms and variations of sound.
* Proficient data entry/computer skills.
* Work as a team. Must be able to pool our knowledge and energy to work in tandem to completely understand and productively respond to all business challenges.

Work Environment – Environmental or atmospheric conditions commonly associated with the performance of the functions of this job.
 

* Protective equipment such as hard hats, safety glasses, air masks, ear protection, chemical suits, hot gloves, high voltage protective equipment and other equipment must be worn in the performance of some duties.
* Work with hazardous materials may be required.
* Requires working extended working hours with weekend and holiday work as required by workload and plant conditions. On call status (day and night).
* Includes working indoors and outdoors.

Physical Abilities - that are commonly associated with the performance of the functions of this job. The physical demands described below represent those that an employee must meet to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.
 

* Physical requirements include possibility of working on foot for extensive periods, requiring stairs and ladder climbing; and routinely lifting 50 pounds.
* All employees will participate in the Fitness for Duty Program. This program includes a post offer physical examination and drug screening and post-employment random drug screening.
* There are extensive smoking restrictions in and around the facility.
* Must be able to work in elevated areas, confined spaces and in extreme heat and cold conditions.
* This role is not open to receiving agency candidates or 3rd Party recruiters; no contingency candidate submissions will be accepted.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees may be required to follow other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties as requested, subject to all applicable state and federal laws. Certain job functions described herein may be subject to possible modification in accordance with applicable state and federal laws.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, marital status, age, sex, or any other status protected by applicable law.

card.title: Sr. Manager - Continuous Improvement
card.description:
Lead continuous improvement at our Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility, where your work will shape performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. As a key member of the plant leadership team, you will set the CI vision, advise site leaders on strategy and lead a team of continuous improvement professionals.

You will own the plant's management operating system and annual cost-out process while building the capabilities that sustain results. This role combines enterprise-level thinking with daily visibility on the plant floor, giving you the opportunity to turn data, Lean methods and cross-functional partnership into measurable operational gains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set and execute the plant's continuous improvement strategy, creating the behaviors, systems and culture needed to achieve plant goals.
* Lead, coach and develop the salaried continuous improvement team while building Lean problem-solving capability across functions.
* Own the plant management operating system, annual cost-out process and A3 strategy documents, including daily, weekly and monthly performance tracking.
* Identify, scope and prioritize breakthrough and incremental improvement opportunities using plant data and operational metrics.
* Teach and model root-cause analysis, DMAIC, standard work, waste reduction, recurrence prevention and structured follow-up.
* Facilitate Kaizen events and cross-functional improvement efforts that strengthen safety, quality, delivery, cost, yield and equipment effectiveness.
* Maintain the plant continuous improvement project docket, track savings and communicate project status and results to operations leadership.
* Partner with operations, engineering and technical teams to implement sustainable solutions and share best practices across PCB facilities.
* Serve as a change leader who constructively challenges non-value-added work and helps teams navigate resistance to change.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

* A visible seat on the plant leadership team with direct influence on site strategy and operational performance.
* The opportunity to build CI capability across the organization and leave a clear handprint on how the plant works.
* Broad collaboration with operations, engineering and CI leaders across Post Consumer Brands.
* A role where big company resources meet a practical, hands-on plant environment.

**Location & Travel Requirements**

* This role is based at the Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility.

**Education**

* A bachelor's degree in science, engineering, management or a related field is preferred.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5 or more years of related experience in a manufacturing environment.
* 3 or more years of successful leadership experience guiding teams that execute continuous improvement or Lean Six Sigma work.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable efficiency, effectiveness and financial benefits through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience operating in a large manufacturing plant environment.
* Deep working knowledge of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methods, including root-cause analysis, DMAIC, Kaizen and waste reduction.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects, use operational data to set priorities and sustain improvements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in food manufacturing.
* Experience working in a union manufacturing environment.
* Experience in food or automotive manufacturing settings.
* Experience leading Black Belt-level or transformational cost-out initiatives.

**Success in This Role**

* Builds trust and strong working relationships across plant leadership, operations, engineering and frontline teams.
* Influences, coaches and develops others while setting clear expectations and maintaining accountability for results.
* Communicates a compelling improvement vision and translates complex problems into organized, practical action plans.
* Uses sound analytical and business judgment to solve complex problems and prioritize actions quickly.
* Leads change with candor, optimism and respect, including in environments where established ways of working may be challenged.
* Demonstrates a consistent commitment to a safe, respectful workplace.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are ready to lead transformational improvement, develop strong teams and help a large manufacturing operation perform at its best, bring your experience and big ambitions to Post Consumer Brands.

card.description:
**Plant Manager**

**Manufacturing Operations | Color Compounding and Synthetic Turf Yarn Extrusion**

Company

TenCate

 

Location

Dayton, Tennessee

 

Department

Manufacturing / Operations

 

Reports To

VP of Manufacturing

 

Position Type

Full-Time

**About Us**

TenCate brings together specialized businesses in synthetic turf manufacturing, sports surfacing, construction, and related services. Our operations combine manufacturing expertise, product innovation, and customer-focused execution to support high-performing athletic environments.

**Position Summary**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership and performance of the Dayton manufacturing facility, which includes color compounding and extrusion of synthetic turf yarn. This role has accountability for safe operations, product quality, production performance, cost control, staffing, maintenance coordination, continuous improvement, third-party yarn sales, and sourcing of raw materials.

The Plant Manager will provide strong day-to-day leadership while building the systems, accountability, and capabilities necessary to support future growth. The successful candidate will be a visible, hands-on leader who is comfortable working directly with production teams while also managing plant performance through data and clearly defined operating metrics.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Safety and Compliance**

* Maintain a strong safety culture with clear expectations and accountability at all levels of the plant.

* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements and company standards.

* Drive identification and correction of unsafe conditions and operating practices.

**Manufacturing Operations**

* Lead daily operations across color compounding and turf-yarn extrusion.

* Ensure production schedules are achieved while maintaining safety and quality requirements.

* Optimize machine utilization, throughput, labor, and manufacturing efficiency.

* Identify and eliminate production bottlenecks, excessive downtime, scrap, and waste.

* Ensure effective shift-to-shift communication and production reporting.

* Coordinate production priorities with planning, supply chain, quality, maintenance, and other manufacturing locations.

**Quality**

* Ensure products consistently meet established specifications and customer requirements.

* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for quality issues, scrap, and customer complaints.

* Maintain strong process controls around color consistency, raw materials, extrusion conditions, and finished-yarn performance.

* Partner with Quality and Technical teams on process and product improvements.

**Cost and Productivity**

* Manage plant performance against budget and operating targets.

* Drive improvements in labor efficiency, material yield, waste, energy consumption, downtime, and overall manufacturing cost.

* Monitor plant KPIs and develop corrective actions when performance falls below target.

* Identify and execute continuous-improvement and cost-reduction opportunities.

**Commercial and Raw Material Sourcing**

* Manage third-party yarn sales, including customer coordination, pricing support, order execution, and alignment of external commitments with available plant capacity.

* Develop and maintain productive relationships with third-party yarn customers while ensuring service, quality, and profitability expectations are met.

* Lead sourcing and supplier coordination for key raw materials used in color compounding and turf-yarn extrusion.

* Partner with Supply Chain, Technical, Quality, and Finance to evaluate suppliers, material performance, cost, availability, and supply risk.

* Support negotiations, purchasing strategies, inventory planning, and contingency plans that ensure reliable and cost-effective raw material supply.

**People Leadership**

* Provide leadership and direction to supervisors, technical resources, and hourly manufacturing associates.

* Establish clear responsibilities, expectations, and accountability throughout the organization.

* Develop supervisors and future manufacturing leaders.

* Ensure appropriate staffing and training to meet production requirements.

* Create a culture of teamwork, urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Maintenance and Reliability**

* Partner with maintenance to improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

* Establish appropriate preventive and predictive maintenance priorities.

* Support equipment upgrades, capital projects, and manufacturing process improvements.

* Ensure recurring equipment issues receive appropriate root-cause analysis and corrective action.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Use production data and structured problem-solving to drive measurable improvements.

* Establish standardized work and disciplined operating processes.

* Lead improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, output, yield, labor productivity, uptime, and cost.

* Support future capacity planning, equipment additions, and manufacturing expansion as required.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant manufacturing leadership experience in a plant or production environment.

* Demonstrated experience leading hourly manufacturing teams and front-line supervisors.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing KPIs, including safety, quality, throughput, downtime, yield/scrap, labor efficiency, and cost.

* Demonstrated ability to drive operational improvement and hold teams accountable for results.

* Strong problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.

* Demonstrated commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer requirements, plant capacity, material availability, and profitability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field.

* Experience with plastic extrusion, polymer processing, synthetic fibers, masterbatch/color compounding, or similar continuous manufacturing processes.

* Lean manufacturing or continuous-improvement experience.

* Experience managing a multi-shift manufacturing operation.

* Familiarity with capital projects, process automation, and equipment reliability programs.

* Experience with third-party or business-to-business sales in a manufacturing environment.

* Experience sourcing polymers, additives, color concentrates, packaging, or other manufacturing raw materials.

**Key Measures of Success**

* Safety performance

* First-quality / right-first-time production

* Schedule attainment

* Pounds produced / throughput

* Scrap and waste percentage

* Labor efficiency

* Machine uptime / unplanned downtime

* Manufacturing cost per pound

* Customer complaints and internal quality issues

* Energy consumption per pound produced

* Employee training, development, and retention

* Third-party yarn sales revenue and profitability

* Third-party customer service and on-time delivery

* Raw material cost, availability, quality, and supplier performance

* Raw material inventory and supply continuity

**Work Environment**

This position requires regular presence in a manufacturing environment and the ability to work across shifts as business needs require. The Plant Manager must be able to communicate effectively with hourly associates, technical teams, support functions, and senior leadership.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

The company is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law.

This description summarizes the general nature and level of work performed and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities or qualifications. Duties may change based on business needs.

Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Operations Director***

***Salary:*** *$90,000 - $120,000*

***Shift:*** *Monday to Friday 1st shift*

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Manages and directs all manufacturing and production activities including shift quality and quality of work
* Monitors overall plant performance for production and comply with all quality standards
* Familiarity with AS9100, NADCAP & ISO9001 standards & audits
* Works with multiple cross functional groups (Quality, Scheduling, Assembly, Procurement, Supply Chain, Facilities/Maintenance, etc.)
* Reviews production and operating reports and resolves operational/manufacturing problems to ensure minimum costs and prevent operational delays and to meet future growth.
* Uses problem-solving skills and analytical abilities to develop innovative and expedient solutions
* Applies Lean principles and production metrics to make informed decisions and drive continuous improvement processes
* Lead and motivate team members to achieve company/department goals while providing direction, development and leadership to production management team
* Provides training, problem solving, and interpersonal skills to diminish conflict and handle employee issues
* Works overtime and occasional weekend shifts as required to support production needs.
* Ensure ITAR/EAR restriction and regulations are followed

**Education/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and 5 years management experience in manufacturing environment; or 8+ years related management experience and training in a manufacturing environment 2
* 2+ years’ experience in aerospace industry
* CNC machining experience required
* Knowledge of NDT, paint, and chemical processing required
* Strong business acumen with proven leadership skills
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

card.title: Vice President of Manufacturing & Operations
card.description:
For more than three decades, Design West Technologies Inc. has been a trusted Department of War (DoW) partner, delivering mission-critical engineering and rugged manufacturing solutions supporting our nation's warfighters. Building on this defense heritage, DWT is embracing a growth-oriented, start-up culture aligned with evolving DoW opportunities. Based in Tustin, CA, DWT seeks an experienced Vice President of Manufacturing & Operations to lead manufacturing, production, supply chain, facilities, and operational functions. The ideal candidate brings proven aerospace, defense, or complex manufacturing leadership experience, combining strategic vision with hands-on execution to drive growth, organizational transformation, operational excellence, and accountability.

### **Position Overview**

As VP of Manufacturing & Operations, you will provide strategic leadership while maintaining hands-on engagement across daily manufacturing execution, production performance, and operational priorities. You will develop and scale DWT's manufacturing capabilities, integrating people, processes, technology, and resources to drive operational excellence and sustainable growth. You will have executive accountability for manufacturing performance, P&L, capacity, supply chain, quality, safety, and customer delivery while ensuring operational capabilities support current and future business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manufacturing & Operations Excellence**

 

* Lead manufacturing functions, including production, planning, engineering, facilities, maintenance, and warehouse operations.
* Scale manufacturing capabilities, capacity, and infrastructure to support new program launches, increased customer demand, and long-term business growth.
* Drive operational excellence through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and 5S, improving throughput, productivity, automation, equipment utilization, and capacity while establishing KPIs, corrective actions, and scalable processes.

**Supply Chain Management**

* Lead Supply Chain, Procurement, and Production Planning to ensure alignment with business objectives and customer commitments.
* Optimize procurement, supplier performance, material availability, lead times, and inventory while controlling excess and obsolete materials.
* Align production schedules with customer demand, program requirements, and manufacturing capacity while strengthening supply chain resilience through proactive risk mitigation

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Partner with Quality and Engineering leadership to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, regulatory, and quality requirements while promoting safety and accountability.
* Ensure compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001, ITAR, OSHA, and government-contracting requirements while driving audit readiness, corrective actions, defect reduction, and continuous improvement.

**Financial & Business Strategy**

* Own manufacturing P&L performance, including operating budgets, financial forecasts, labor costs, cost controls, capital expenditures, margins, and profitability, ensuring financial accountability and alignment with business objectives.
* Partner with the President and Finance leadership on operating plans, financial forecasts, capital investments, and performance metrics.
* Drive margin improvement through operational efficiency, automation, resource optimization, and process redesign while supporting strategic growth and business expansion.

**Cross-Functional & Organizational Leadership**

* Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align operational priorities, resources, and manufacturing objectives with business strategy.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Program Management to support production readiness, program execution, customer commitments, and new business opportunities.
* Build high-performing teams through clear accountability, coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and leadership development while fostering collaboration, trust, and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* 12–15+ years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years in senior leadership overseeing multiple functions.
* Proven experience managing complex manufacturing operations, P&L, budgets, capital investments, production planning, capacity, quality, delivery, and supply chain.
* Demonstrated success in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, operational strategy, business growth, organizational transformation, and cross-functional leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, electronics, precision, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, preferably involving PCBA, microelectronics, ruggedized electronics, cable and harness assemblies, or complex electromechanical products.
* Experience scaling operations, integrating acquisitions, or leading organizational transformation. MBA, Master's degree, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification preferred.

**Are you ready to join our team?**

At DWT, we value teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement as we build for the future.

We are an **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** including disability/Vets

card.description:
**PLANT MANAGER**

**Icon Fixtures | Multi-Facility Manufacturing Operations | St. Louis Area (Hazelwood, MO)**

About Icon

Icon Fixtures designs and builds custom fixtures, millwork, and full environments for retail, restaurant, hospitality, banking, and museum clients across North America and internationally, from single-store orders to 100+ location rollouts. Our in-house production centers on custom wood cabinetry and architectural millwork, along with metal fabrication and solid surface components.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Plant Manager to lead manufacturing, warehouse, and assembly operations across three local facilities. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will oversee approximately 30 employees through supervisors and team leaders, with significant room to grow the organization as we expand.

This is a role for a builder. The right leader will establish the scheduling systems, standards, and leadership structure that allow Icon to scale without sacrificing quality.

What You Will Do

* Lead manufacturing across all three facilities, including woodworking, cabinetry, millwork, metal, solid surface, finishing, and assembly.

* Build and own production schedules that reflect project deadlines, material availability, labor capacity, and equipment, and identify problems before they affect delivery.

* Run warehouse and assembly operations: receiving, inventory control, material flow between facilities, and preparation for shipment and installation.

* Coordinate material purchasing and production priorities with project management, engineering, and logistics.

* Develop supervisors and team leaders into a management team that runs daily operations independently; recruit, train, and retain skilled employees.

* Set and enforce quality standards against shop drawings and specifications, and reduce defects, rework, and waste.

* Manage labor costs, overtime, and operating budgets; track KPIs and report on performance, capacity, and staffing.

* Lead lean and continuous improvement initiatives, including facility layouts, workflows, and equipment utilization.

* Own safety and facilities: OSHA compliance, combustible dust and dust collection (NFPA 652/664), finishing and spray booth compliance, and preventive maintenance.

What You Bring

* 7+ years of manufacturing leadership, preferably in custom manufacturing, cabinetry, millwork, architectural woodworking, or commercial fixture production.

* Experience managing multiple departments or facilities and 30+ employees through supervisors and team leaders.

* Strong command of project-based production scheduling, labor planning, and manufacturing costs.

* Experience overseeing warehouse, inventory, material handling, and assembly operations.

* Ability to read and interpret shop drawings, production drawings, and specifications.

* Familiarity with ERP systems and production tracking tools.

* A proven record of developing people and building accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

* Retail store fixture manufacturing experience.

* Knowledge of CNC panel processing, edgebanding, and cabinet construction; familiarity with metal fabrication and solid surface.

* Experience implementing lean manufacturing.

* Experience scaling operations during periods of rapid growth.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistent, efficient operations across all three facilities.

* Projects delivered on schedule and within production budgets.

* Reliable schedules and predictable workflow.

* Reduced waste, rework, and unnecessary overtime.

* Strong department leaders and an accountable workforce.

* High standards of workmanship, quality, and workplace safety.

Why Icon

You will have significant influence over Icon’s manufacturing operations, workforce development, and future growth, with the opportunity to grow into a Director-level role. We are looking for a hands-on, results-oriented leader who understands custom manufacturing, develops people, and takes ownership of operational performance.

Pay: $105,000.00 - $140,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary:** Responsible for constructing cabinets and their components through assembly and sub-assembly of various components and materials.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Assemble various cabinet components and materials.
* Safely operate assigned equipment.
* Proficiently use a tape measure to determine sizes for parts.
* Maintain no more than a one-percent rejection rate per workday.
* Supply the sufficient amount of parts in the buffers established by the schedule.
* Inspect component parts prior to working on them and again after they have been machined for correct specifications.

**Qualifications:**

* Must have a high school diploma or equivalent.
* Must have mathematical skills to take measurements on cabinets and materials.
* Must have corrected hearing to listen to needs and instructions of managers and coworkers, and listen to the environment to be aware of surroundings.
* Must have corrected vision to be aware of surroundings and locations of items needed.
* Should have knowledge of/or ability to use a tape measure, saws, drills, and other hand tools.
* Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment.

**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Stands and walks up to a total of ten hours per day on a concrete surface.
* Lifts and carries cabinets, parts, and tools in accordance with the requirements listed in the matrices below, frequently and repetitively for up to ten hours a day.
* Pushes and pulls items in accordance with the requirements listed in the matrices below in order to transfer components for assembly.
* Bends and stoops to reach areas difficult to access.
* Performs twisting and rotation motions using head/neck, waist, knees, and arms while assembling cabinets.
* Frequently reaches in order to attach parts and complete final assembly of cabinets.
* Handles drills, hand tools, hardware, and cabinet parts. Handling may be done unilaterally (one-handed) or bilaterally (two-handed) depending on the size and shape of the task being performed.
* Constantly uses fingers in order to attach hardware, doors, and various parts to finished cabinets.
* Must be mentally alert and capable of remembering faces, names, oral instructions, and details of varying types and sizes of materials and cabinets.
* Must be able to communicate effectively with management and coworkers by phone or in-person.
* Must be mentally altered and capable of remembering oral instructions and routine tasks.
* Must be able to withstand fluctuations in temperature and environmental fluctuations.
* Must be able to work the required daily and weekly work hours as determined by the schedule.
* Good attendance and punctuality are necessary.
* Must exemplify through appearance and behavior the company’s image of excellence.
* Must be alert and able to identify and respond to a hazard by either reporting it immediately, or by taking corrective measures if directed.

**Working Location: Massachusetts, Westborough**

**Workplace Flexibility: Hybrid**

 

***For more than 100 years, Olympus has focused on making people’s lives healthier, safer and more fulfilling.***

Every day, we live by our philosophy, True to Life, by advancing medical technologies and elevating the standard of patient care so people everywhere can fulfill their desires, dreams, and lives.

**Patient Focus, Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Empathy.**

 

Learn more about Life at Olympus: https://www.olympusamerica.com/careers.

**Job Description**
-------------------

This position provides quality operations leadership to the global distribution operation. The Director of Quality role will provide Quality leadership for the Global Ship Hold process. This scope will include ownership, monitoring and communication of the Global Ship Hold process. In addition, this role will be responsible for managing global strategy and implementation for the quality requirements for inventory handling, segregation and reporting. This position partners closely with the Global Supply Chain Management.

**Job Duties**
--------------

* Serves as the global process owner (GPO) for the Global Ship Hold Process.
* Monitors and manages the initiation, progress and release of global ship holds.
* Develops and executes global communication on the status and action plan of existing global ship holds.
* Partners with the Field Corrective Action (FCA) team on inventory handling and reconciliation of open projects.
* Develops strategic priorities for the global control, disposition and resolution of quality processes for material control.
* Works with regional management and staff to ensure the successful execution of established policies and procedures for inventory management.
* Serves as a global leader to focus a matrixed network of Ship Hold Coordinators.
* Continued monitoring of staff performance to ensure quality and consistency.
* Performs all other duties as directed.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

**Required:**

* BA/BS degree or equivalent in a Life Science, Engineering, or Supply Chain management. Advanced technical degree and/or MBA preferred.
* A minimum of 10 years of cGMP experience in quality management or operations within the MedTech industry.
* Experience with durable medical devices, and a strong understanding of supply chain processes and inventory controls (reverse logistics is a plus).
* Demonstrated experience influencing senior level management, key stakeholders and leveraging crossfunctional partnerships for successful execution of critical quality initiatives.
* Experience interpreting and applying business requirements and regulations (FDA and other applicable global authorities) into sustainable quality processes leveraging industry best practices.
* Experience with global inventory processes and systems (ERP) – including hold mechanisms.
* Experience with warehouse management processes and systems (WMS) including product segregation and control on non-conforming material.

* Persistence to continuously improve, never settling for status quo, while keeping customer satisfaction and customer value central.

* Driving cultural change in a complex and diverse Olympus organization.

* 12 Paid Holidays

* Work-life integrated culture that supports an employee centric mindset
* Offers onsite, hybrid and field work environments
* Paid volunteering and charitable donation/match programs
* Employee Resource Groups
* Dedicated Training Resources and Learning & Development Programs
* Paid Educational Assistance

* US Only

\*\*Center Valley, PA and Westborough, MA

Learn more about our benefits and incentives: https://www.olympusamerica.com/careers/benefits-perks.

Olympus considers a variety of factors when determining actual compensation for this position, including level of experience, working location, and relevant education and certifications.

 

At Olympus, we are committed to Our Purpose of making people’s lives healthier, safer and more fulfilling. If your disability impairs your ability to email, you may call our HR Compliance Manager at 1-888-Olympus (1-888-659-6787).

### **Activités**

**SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering, manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information. The incumbent is responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets in accordance with company policies and customer requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Analyzes, evaluates, and presents information concerning factors such as quality performance, production capabilities, manufacturing problems, customer quality trends, and quality planning of new products for consideration by other members of the management team.
* Presents and evaluates alternative methods and procedures to establish standardized quality systems based on best practices.
* Participates with other top management personnel in formulating and establishing company policies, operating procedures, and goals.
* Participates in review of product development activities and APQP milestones.
* Conducts Quality System Management review meetings with top management to assess performance and compliance to customer quality requirements.
* Reviews technical problems and procedures of departments and recommends solutions to problems or changes in procedures.
* Confers with engineers and managers about quality assurance of new products and process to improve manufacturing capability.
* Reviews technical publications, articles, and abstracts to stay abreast of technical and quality system developments in industry.
* Travel required on a frequent basis to suppliers and customer facilities as well as other Hutchinson facilities.
* Provides internal quality system audit of Hutchinson Sealing Systems locations.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

Master's degree (M.A.) or equivalent; or four to ten years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Qualifications may be waived by management. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**

None.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Manages subordinates in department. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complains and resolving problems.

**TEAM SKILLS:**

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**Raytheon Company, Managed by Collins Aerospace**

We are seeking a dedicated professional to join our team as a Senior Manager, Program Quality Leader. This onsite role, based in El Segundo, CA will support Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) Avionics within Mission Systems. In this role, you will lead efforts and develop teams to effectively implement Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all program phases. You will serve as the primary Quality interface for customers, suppliers, and programs.

**What You Will Do**:

* Develop and lead a team of Program Quality Leads (PQLs) and Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs) to support program execution and deliverables.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to establish effective relationships and influence decision-making across multiple levels within a cross-functional environment at multiple sites.
* Ensure quality requirements are integrated into program estimates and proposals and oversee their consistent application.
* Lead and oversee the implementation of Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all phases of assigned programs.
* Serve as the primary QMA interface for customers, suppliers, and internal program teams, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and expectations.
* Drive strategic improvements to enhance quality processes, reduce defects, and improve overall program performance.
* Oversee the development and application of quality metrics to identify root causes and implement long-term corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory quality standards, including ISO 9001, AS9100, and AS9102.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including program management, operations, and engineering, to ensure process capability, product conformance, and on-time delivery.

* Experience as the direct interface to external customers.

At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.
 
 
For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.
 
 
At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.
 
 
We are looking for a S
**r. Manager, Quality**
to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to
**Director of Quality**
and based in
**Newark, Delaware. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week**
.
 
 
**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure 100% Quality assurance at the Skid line manufacturing through inspection, testing, and sub-component testing/inspection. Assist in hiring personnel needed to support this effort.
* Partner with Install Quality team (field) to understand real time (daily) what items are escaping the plant and instituting immediate mitigation plans including addressing any inventory in the pipeline not yet installed.
* Implement permanent corrective actions working with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply chain, or SQE as per relevance on each issue.
* Provide quality input into the new equipment being purchased for the scaling of Delaware manufacturing. Include inputs for quality assurance into equipment design, and verification of process steps. Understand and provide input into the planned operation, what can be bypassed, maintenance plans, calibration or drift of the equipment, automation that can fail and be undetected leading to quality escapes.
* Participate and understand results from testing in the plant; Functional test, Tommy test, FIT, etc. Drive pareto of failures to help cross functional problem solving of test failures.
* Implement a 100% functional test (new) on skid final product assembly; electrical continuity, communications integrity, piping assurance, start up simulation, etc. to assure 100% QA prior to shipping to customer.
* Ensure skid components and systems have latest FW revision prior to shipping to the W/H, or out of W/H to field.
* Work with CIG and Manufacturing Engr, and NPI to implement workload being removed from the customer install side and being moved into skid assembly. Provide oversight to ensure best quality achievement; ensure work instructions are clear, operators trained, workstations have proper tools, and judgement criteria.
* Collaborate with Supplier Quality / Suppliers to achieve zero-defect flow (“dock-to-stock”) for all purchased, contract manufacture parts, materials, and Bloom Energy manufactured parts.
* Drive component and design failures back to the earliest point of detection in the process.
* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.
* Work collaboratively with Design teams to DFM, through a “registration system”, and Pokeyoke assembly methods for highest quality assurance.
* Drive test excellence in the manufacturing plan to ensure that equipment and test stations are certified with robust qualification programs, that are documented and controlled for changes with proper accuracy and gage R&R techniques.
* Drive yield task forces to achieve company wide targets at each manufacturing point under this scope, with cross functional teams driving top pareto issues to RCCA.
* Ensure early engagement with the product engineering team to teach and perform early stage risk assessments (DFMEA et.al.)
* Design for manufacturability and reliability improvements during the early design stages of product development.
* Work with Engineering NPI and the manufacturing engineering teams to perform PFMEA, write work instructions, and establish quality check-points to guarantee zero-defect quality in production.
* Develop and implement formal, comprehensive process documentation including process flow diagrams, Process FMEAs, process control plans, operations method Sheets, manufacturing quality charts (MQCs) and etc.
* Lead critical problem solving task forces with emphasis on cross functional inputs, accountability, time to RCCA, and ensurance of mitigation of inventory, or field units at risk.
* Troubleshoot product issues by reviewing engineering drawings and design requirements. Drive a rigorous resolution process for product quality, reliability and design issues.
* Perform data-driven root cause failure analyses for design, manufacturing, and administrative problems.
* Perform process audits to monitor, continuously improve, and sustain superior product quality.
* Demonstrate the ability to interface and work collaboratively across departments internally and with suppliers and customers, (including Purchasing, Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Marketing and Finance), while building strong and cooperative working relationships.
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Establish and govern site COPQ metrics (scrap, rework, sorting, and warranty risk); lead cross-functional yield-improvement blitzes targeting measurable cost reductions and scrap minimization.
* Process Capability & Zero-Defect Mentality: Drive process capability (C\_p / C\_{pk} \ge 1.33) across critical-to-quality (CTQ) operations (welding, brazing, ceramic stack assembly, plumbing/gas-delivery, and electrical integration).

**Skills and Experience:**

* More than 10 years of increasing responsibility in the areas of Quality, and Manufacturing .
* Experience implementing company-wide ISO 9001 procedures and TS16949 standards and related process documentation. Possess working knowledge of process capability and control requirements, methods and systems.
* Demonstrated track record of building, restructuring, or significantly scaling a manufacturing quality team during rapid production ramp-up
* Proven successful application of multi-discipline engineering problem solving techniques.
* Understand the critical elements of modern Manufacturing Statistical Process Control, (e.g., practical working knowledge and experience with SPC, Process Capability, Cp, Cpk, etc.)
* Understand the critical elements of modern Reliability Engineering, (e.g., MCF, MTBF, MTT, etc.)
* Certification in a recognized problem-solving methodology such as six-sigma Black Belt, 8D, or Global Problem Solving.
* Strong verbal/active listening/written communications.
* Demonstrate planning and leadership skills.
* Expert with metrology, calibration, and Gage R & R’s.
* Ability to train in Quality System Auditing.
* Fluent in product phase-gate, NPI and technology transfer.
* Expertise in applying PPAP, First Article Inspections (FAI) and Reports).
* Strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and problem solving.
* Ability to effectively work within a very intense, dynamic, fast-paced, and demanding work environment.
* Familiarity with industry codes and quality standards applicable to clean power systems (ISO 9001:2015 required; working knowledge of ASME, NFPA, or UL standards preferred).
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality / Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) and ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) alongside CQE and Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and statistical software.
* Possess a passion for excellence.
* Unrestricted willingness to travel to all regions. Travel may be up to 25% of time.
* BS, MS or PhD in Mechanical/Material Science/Chemical/Electrical/Systems Engineering.
* Direct experience managing high-temperature fluidics/gas delivery, welding/brazing, ceramic integration, power electronics, or structural enclosures is a strong plus.

Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with a large employer contribution, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, generous Mental Health Support services, Legal services, virtual Physical Therapy access, and Fertility & Family Forming benefits.

**Oklahoma City, OK**

**Extremely Competitive Pay** - *Dependent on Experience*

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced quality leader to oversee and advance our quality management program within a growing aerospace manufacturing organization. This position plays a critical role in ensuring product integrity, maintaining customer and regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement throughout the company. Working closely with manufacturing, engineering, and executive leadership, the Director of Quality will lead quality initiatives, develop high-performing teams, strengthen organizational processes, and promote a culture of accountability and operational excellence. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with proven leadership skills and a commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality results.

**Key Responsibilities Include:**

* Implement and maintain the company quality system in coordination with the Management Representative.
* Report on the performance of the quality system for review and as a basis for improvement of the quality system.
* Have knowledge and understanding of the standards and customer requirements against which the quality system is developed, maintained, and implemented.
* Provide leadership to subordinates, establishing goals and development plans to meet the strategic direction of the organization.
Determine and enforce* - through functional groups - quality requirements in accordance with real company needs, based on current regulations and state-of-the art product development.
* Develop audit plans, select, and evaluate auditors, document non-conformance(s) and report non-conformances to management.
* Manage subordinate personnel and ensure proper documentation and methods used are according to the Quality Management System.
* Ensure employees are properly trained to perform their job duties in the manner expected, according to their specific job description.
* Establishes and maintains an effective system of communications throughout the organization.
* Represents the organization with major customers, shareholders, the financial community, and the public.
* Monitor and evaluate subordinate personnel updating the Management Representative and Human Resources to have the Employee Skills Matrix reflect accurately the training and skills of subordinates.
* Administer the company quality program in accordance with customer and company requirements.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are issued, responded, and completed.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives for scrap reduction, reducing variation and waste, increasing profit and to improve product quality.
* Organize and promote companywide quality improvement efforts.
* Liaison with external parties on matters relating to the quality management system.

* Monitor metrics associated with the Cost of Quality.

* 401(k) with Company Match
* Company Sponsored Life-Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays

The employee may occasionally lift or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to focus.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 4-10 years of related experience in manufacturing.

This position is subject to **ITAR regulations.** Candidates must qualify as a **U.S. Person** (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee)
