Omada International is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable civil rights and disability laws.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**Director of Operations**

**Reports To:** VP of Operations

**Department:** Operations

**Location:** Beachwood, Ohio-primary location (Toledo, Nursing Home Programs, and Future Service Locations as needed)

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations is responsible for supporting and executing enterprise operational oversight across multiple behavioral health service lines and locations. This role partners closely with the VP of Operations and executive leadership to ensure operational stability, scalability, compliance, staffing coordination, workflow management, and organizational performance across all assigned programs.

The Director of Operations serves as a key operational leader responsible for driving consistency, accountability, and operational execution across outpatient behavioral health programs, recovery support services, housing operations, nursing home partnerships, and future organizational growth initiatives.

This is a non-clinical leadership role. The Director of Operations does not provide clinical supervision or determine clinical level of care decisions, but works collaboratively with Clinical, Revenue Cycle, Housing, Intake, Human Resources, and Executive Leadership teams to ensure efficient and compliant operational performance across the enterprise.

This position requires the ability to exercise sound independent judgment, make operational decisions autonomously when appropriate, prioritize competing organizational needs, and respond effectively to rapidly changing operational demands across multiple service lines and locations.

This position is designed to support long-term operational leadership continuity across the organization. Responsibilities may expand or shift based on organizational structure, operational needs, leadership transitions, and enterprise growth initiatives.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Enterprise Operational Oversight
* Support and oversee daily operational functions across multiple behavioral health programs and service locations
* Assist with operational oversight of outpatient behavioral health clinics, recovery support services, housing operations, nursing home partnerships, and future service expansions
* Ensure operational consistency, accountability, and workflow execution across enterprise locations
* Monitor operational performance, staffing needs, workflow barriers, and service delivery coordination
* Independently identify operational issues and implement timely solutions within the scope of organizational expectations
* Exercise independent decision-making related to operational workflow management, staffing coordination, scheduling adjustments, and day-to-day operational needs
* Assist with development and implementation of operational systems, policies, workflows, and accountability structures
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvement initiatives
* Support organizational scalability and stabilization efforts

**Staffing & Workflow Management**

* Oversee operational scheduling processes and staffing coordination across assigned programs
* Monitor staffing coverage, workflow efficiency, transportation coordination, and operational throughput
* Collaborate with department leaders regarding staffing support, scheduling concerns, and operational barriers
* Make operational decisions related to staffing coverage, workflow prioritization, and operational resource allocation when appropriate
* Ensure operational follow-up on workflow disruptions, scheduling gaps, cancellations, and staffing needs
* Support census oversight, operational capacity management, and throughput planning

**Interdepartmental Leadership**

* Partner collaboratively with Clinical, Housing, Revenue Cycle, Intake, Human Resources, Compliance, and Executive Leadership teams
* Support organizational alignment between operational and clinical departments
* Participate in leadership meetings, operational huddles, and enterprise planning initiatives
* Escalate operational concerns, risks, and barriers appropriately
* Assist with implementation of organizational initiatives, workflow changes, and operational directives
* Utilize critical thinking and independent judgment to support operational problem-solving and organizational decision-making

**Compliance & Accountability**

* Support operational compliance with company policies, workflows, regulatory standards, and organizational expectations
* Monitor operational accountability measures and ensure timely completion of assigned operational responsibilities
* Assist leadership with KPI tracking, operational reporting, and performance management initiatives
* Support implementation of corrective action plans related to operational performance concerns
* Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and organizational integrity in all operational activities

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Assist with onboarding, orientation, and operational training initiatives for staff
* Provide operational leadership presence across enterprise locations
* Support leadership development and operational mentoring initiatives
* Assist with operational planning for organizational growth and expansion efforts
* Serve as a developing enterprise operational leader within the organization
* Demonstrate the ability to independently lead operational initiatives and maintain organizational continuity during leadership transitions or operational restructuring

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in healthcare operations, behavioral health operations, substance use disorder treatment, or healthcare leadership required
* Previous operational leadership or multi-site management experience preferred
* Strong understanding of operational workflow management, staffing coordination, and organizational accountability
* Demonstrated ability to make independent operational decisions in a fast-paced healthcare environment
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across multiple service lines and locations
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills required
* Experience working within multidisciplinary healthcare environments preferred
* Knowledge of behavioral health operations, recovery services, housing operations, or outpatient treatment environments preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, scheduling systems, reporting systems, and electronic health records preferred

**Core Competencies**

* Enterprise operational leadership
* Workflow optimization
* Organizational accountability
* Strategic problem-solving
* Ability to make independent decisions when needed
* Team collaboration
* Communication and conflict resolution
* Operational scalability
* Time management and prioritization
* Leadership development
* Adaptability and change management
* Ability to manage competing operational priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Professional judgment and critical thinking

**Physical & Travel Requirements**

* Ability to travel regularly between locations as needed
* Ability to work occasional evenings or weekends based on organizational needs
* Ability to move throughout facilities and remain stationary for extended periods as needed

**Organizational Structure Statement**

This position is intended to support long-term operational leadership continuity across the enterprise. The Director of Operations may assume expanded operational oversight responsibilities based on organizational structure, business needs, leadership transitions, and enterprise growth initiatives.

card.description:
What if... we could build the operational backbone that gets Flagship's most transformative medicines from the lab bench to the patient, reliably and at scale?

Pioneering Medicines (PM), an initiative of Flagship Pioneering, is building a world-class biopharmaceutical R&D capability focused on conceiving and developing life-changing treatments for patients by harnessing the power of Flagship's scientific platforms and applying those innovative approaches to serious diseases with unmet medical need. Unique to Pioneering Medicines' approach is the opportunity to combine platforms to create truly novel and potentially transformative treatments.

**About Flagship Pioneering:**

Flagship Pioneering conceives, creates, resources, and develops first-in-category life science platform companies to transform human health and sustainability. Since its founding in 2000, the firm has originated and fostered the development of more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in over $34 billion in aggregate value, 500+ issued patents, and more than 50 clinical trials for novel therapeutic agents.

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking a Senior Director, Supply Operations with a proven track record of establishing and running supply chain and operations functions within a fast-paced pharmaceutical or biotech environment, including supporting multiple emerging-modality programs simultaneously. This leader will build and lead the Supply Operations function within Technical Operations (TechOps), owning supply chain management and shaping the operating model that connects technical teams with external partners, and jointly leading vendor management responsibilities. This position reports to the VP, Strategy & Operations, TechOps.

This leader will own the strategy and design of how material and product flow from external partners through to animal / clinical studies, lead day-to-day coordination in partnership with technical SMEs, and serve as an operational point of contact for Pioneering Medicines' CDMOs and suppliers. This role operates at the intersection of science, strategy, and operations, setting supply direction across a complex multimodality pipeline and building external supply operations as a competitive advantage for Pioneering Medicines. As a build-and-own mandate, this role will define and scale a lean, phase-appropriate operating model (the systems and processes) that accommodates the distinct supply requirements of multiple and emerging modalities and grows with the organization and strategic direction.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and design the Supply Operations function within TechOps, directing supply chain management and jointly leading vendor management responsibilities. Own strategy, roadmap, and investment decisions for the function, and oversee budget and resourcing across an expanding portfolio of programs and modalities running simultaneously at different stages of development.

* Own end-to-end supply operations, including demand and supply planning, inventory management, cold chain/logistics, raw material sourcing coordination, lot and batch

management, and CDMO manufacturing scheduling, so material and product reach the clinic on schedule. Tailor supply models to the distinct needs of each modality (e.g., small molecules, biologics, nucleic acids/LNP, cell and gene therapies), including storage, shipping, shelf-life, and chain of identity/custody requirements.

* Serve as a senior operational point of contact for CDMOs and suppliers, leading day-to-day coordination (scheduling, shipments, issue resolution) jointly with the relevant technical SMEs. Build CDMO relationships and anticipate portfolio capacity needs for emerging modalities (e.g., viral vector, plasmid DNA, mRNA/LNP, cell therapy), balancing competing demand for CDMO slots, specialized raw materials, and resources across concurrent programs.

* Develop the function's core work instructions, SOPs, process flows, and supply chain network and capacity maps (primary, back-up, and qualified supplier options) for every active program and modality, including single-source and long-lead risks. Stand up and scale the operating platform as the organization grows, including planning trackers, CDMO/3PL portal oversight, and AI-enabled automation of supply planning, lot tracking, and cold chain monitoring.

* Establish and govern the Material Master Registry and lot-level inventory visibility across drug substance, drug product, clinical trial material, and raw materials; oversee shipment, chain of custody, and clinical distribution, including excursion response in partnership with QA.

* Serve as the operational interface between Technical SMEs, Quality, Program Management, and Finance (owning the "how" while technical teams own the "what") and build the RACI that clarifies ownership at every manufacturing and distribution stage, including joint ownership of external supply operations with technical SMEs.

* Lead supply input into program planning, cross-program prioritization, risk identification, and milestone tracking in alignment with CMC/technical timelines. Communicate status, risks, and decisions to senior leadership, and drive budgeting, financial tracking, and continuous process improvement across the function.

* Jointly lead vendor management responsibilities including onboarding, performance management (KPIs/SLAs), and vendor risk and compliance monitoring, in partnership with Legal and Finance; help shape the governance framework and escalation paths for key partners.

* Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing supply operations team; set goals, mentor and coach direct reports, and build the talent pipeline needed to scale the function.

* Represent Supply Operations to Flagship platform companies, external partners, and industry, and champion Pioneering Medicines' clinical supply capabilities.

 

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific or technical field (advanced degree preferred) with 12+ years of progressive experience in supply chain, technical/CMC operations, or external manufacturing coordination within a pharmaceutical or biotech organization; minimum 5 years in a leadership capacity with direct accountability for supply/operations strategy.

* Demonstrated experience building or scaling an operations or supply chain function in an early-to-mid-stage environment (not just inheriting an existing system), including designing lean, phase-appropriate operating models, governance structures, and SOPs.

* Extensive experience working with CDMOs, CROs, and other external manufacturing/service partners on scheduling, execution, technology transfer, and issue resolution; formal contract negotiation or vendor governance experience (MSA/SOW/DMSA) preferred.

* Working knowledge of GMP requirements as they relate to material control, chain of custody, inventory management, and vendor qualification, including modality-specific considerations such as ultra-cold/cryogenic storage and shipping, chain of identity for patient-specific products, and handling of viral or hazardous materials; experience supporting implementation of phase-appropriate quality systems across research and clinical programs.

* Proven track record delivering supply/operations execution across a multi-program, multi-modality portfolio (hands-on experience with small molecules and biologics required; experience with advanced or emerging modalities such as nucleic acids, cell, or gene therapies preferred), including budget development, resource planning, risk management, and delivery against aggressive timelines while managing multiple concurrent programs at different phases and resolving competing demands on shared capacity and resources.

* Experience leading or supporting contract execution for CMC programs, ensuring financial alignment, vendor accountability, and cross-functional coordination.

* Executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence and align cross-functional partners (including Technical, Quality, Finance, Legal, and Program Management) without direct authority; strong communicator able to translate complex supply chain and operational risk for non-specialist audiences.

* Direct people management experience, including goal setting, performance evaluation, coaching, and development of team members; experience building talent pipelines and mentoring within a matrixed organization.

* Entrepreneurial builder energized by creating structure in ambiguous, fast-moving environments; high accountability orientation with a bias for action and the ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information.

* Collaborative, low-ego leadership style with genuine investment in team development and cross-functional relationships.

Flagship Pioneering and our ecosystem companies are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

If you are a current DSV employee and interested in a position in another country,please contact your Human Resource representative to discuss the process and requirements of applying.

Job area: Managerial

**DSV - Global transport and logistics**
 
In 1976, ten independent haulers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global, yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

 

**Location**: USA - Fort Worth, 9401 Hemphill St

**Division**: Solutions

**Job Posting Title**: Director, Operations

**Time Type**: Full Time

 

**SUMMARY**

The Director of Operations provides overall direction and guidance to the operational activities of the organization. Provides strategic leadership and management to Operations within a large geographic region. The Regional Director of Operations will strive to maximize growth and profitability while responsibly managing the resources of their region according to the company and client expectations and policies. Develops and implements long and short-term strategies to achieve financial and growth targets. Develops emerging talent and successors and creates a work environment that promotes the values of DSV.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for supporting the company strategy including growth and transformational initiatives.
* Develop regional strategies to align with enterprise targets.
* Ensure targets are achieved and local needs are also met.
* Plans and budgets regional financial targets.
* Responsible for ensuring results are achieved against targets.
* Ensure operational excellence within and across our core services.
* Ensures operational excellence through standardization of existing practices, risk assessment and review of key metrics.
* Provides leadership and creates an environment that fosters passion, teamwork and agility within the organization.
* Ensures initiatives are developed and executed in the selection and development of talent and creates an environment that improves associate engagement.
* Build and sustains long-term client relationships.
* Supports local, regional and global sales initiatives by partnering with key clients and delivering a high level of client focus to business initiatives.
* Plans and successfully execute start-up facilities for new business.
* Spearheads teams and partners with clients to trouble-shoot and solve existing issues or problems.
* Contributes as a key member to our sales and solutions team in winning key strategic accounts.
* Develops and implements an operations strategy tailored to our client that identifies opportunities to improve cost control and margin improvement and will lead to organic growth.
* Consistently works within a complex matrixed environment.
* Works collaboratively and establishes solid business relationships with supporting departments including but not limited to: Human Resources, Sales, and Finance.
 

**OTHER DUTIES**

* Performs special projects as required
 

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* The Regional Director of Operations directly supervises General Managers.
* Responsible for overall management to achieve client satisfaction.
* Must interpret policies, purposes, and goals of the organization for subordinates.
* Responsible for performance management of direct reports.
* Builds bench strength by leading, developing and challenging operations teams to raise individual and collective performance levels by demonstrating and promoting discretionary effort.
 

**MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and/or Experience

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or logistics or equivalent fields is required
* A minimum of 10 years’ logistics operations management experience with big box", e-commerce or specialty retailers and at least 5 years’ experience as a regional operations leader managing multiple locations.
 

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Education and/or Experience

* Master’s degree preferred.
* Third-party logistics experience is preferred but not required.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations or Professional Designations

* Involvement in relevant professional organizations is desirable
 

**SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES**

Computer Skills

* Strong proficiency in MS Office applications is needed.
* Working knowledge of industry WMS

Language Skills

* English (reading, writing, and verbal)

Mathematical Skills

* Intermediate mathematical, accounting, and financial skills

Other Skills

* Excellent verbal, written and visual/presentation communication skills.
* Must be adept at navigating within a matrixed organizational structure.
* Results-oriented and able to work and meet timelines.
* Ability to work well under pressure and multi-task.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a complex matrix environment across multiple levels within the organization.
* Ability to motivate and inspire others to achieve.
* Ability to question and challenge existing ways of thinking.
* Experience in a “client-centric" environment with accountability for both operations metrics and client relations.
* Must excel at and enjoy teaming with members of the operations team and client representatives to trouble-shoot and solve existing problems.
* Direct experience preparing budgets and actively participating in financial reviews with a solid understanding of standard and actual cost variances
* Has led high-performing teams. Can recruit, develop and motivate superior talent
* Possess the ability to motivate and maintain effective working relationships with staff and partners.
* Ability to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
* Successfully work to reach company goals in an environment in which a wide degree of creativity and latitude is required
* Integration experience with the supply chain industry is helpful
 

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee uses his/her hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, or crouch; talk or hear. The employee uses computer and telephone equipment. Specific vision requirements of this job include close vision and distance vision. May require physical effort associated with using the computer to access information, or occasional standing, walking, lifting needed to carry out everyday activities. Travel may be required for this role domestically.

 

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee rarely is exposed to fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

 

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described above are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

For this position, the expected base pay range is $180,000.00 – $200,000.00 Annual. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location, in accordance with applicable laws and company policy.

 

Information regarding DSV’s benefits offerings, including eligibility, coverage options, and plan details, is available through the DSV Benefits Showcase. Benefits, programs, and eligibility may vary by location and division in accordance with applicable state and local laws.

 

DSV is an equal employment opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, age, sex, religion, ancestry, disability, veteran status, marital status, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. If you require special assistance or accommodation while seeking employment with DSV, please contact Human Resources at hr@us.dsv.com. If you are interested in learning the status of your application, please note you will be contacted directly by the appropriate human resources contact person if you are selected for further consideration. DSV reserves the right to defer or close a vacancy at any time.

 

**DSV – Global transport and logistics**

**What moves you?**

At DSV, we move more than goods. We move careers, ambitions and opportunities.

 

With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we are the global leader in transport and logistics, and it is our people who bring our services and solutions to life every day. From frontline operations to business functions, every role contributes to keeping supply chains flowing and societies running.

 

Here, you are trusted to take ownership, act on your ideas and make decisions that create real impact. It is a place where people, careers and ideas keep moving forward. We value transparency in how we communicate and collaborate, and we win together by supporting each other, challenging each other and delivering results as a team.

 

**Start here. Go anywhere**

This is our promise of movement. A promise that your work matters, your contribution counts, and your career can move as far as your ambition takes it.

If you are looking to make an impact, grow your career and be part of something bigger, DSV is the place to be.

Visit dsv.com

#StartHereGoAnywhere #LifeAtDSV
